record.provider: 华为云空间 / HUAWEI Mobile Cloud

free_tier.stated: In the new cloud space, 基础服务 is unlimited free storage, which replaced the former free 5 GB, and holds fixed system data: contacts, notes, calendar, browser, apps and SMS

retention.stated: 基础服务 holds contacts, SMS and notes with no fixed size; photos and video need 会员服务. No retention clock published

egress.terms: No documented cap, but the service is sync-oriented and offers no public sharing of the drive

record.tooling: two distinct APIs. The consumer one is reverse-engineered at driveapis.cloud.huawei.com.cn behind an OAuth bearer token, and RzdPai/Huawei_Cloud_Webdav exposes it as WebDAV, which is the useful part. KooDrive is a separate enterprise product with official documentation and must not be conflated with it
record.chaining: A WebDAV bridge exists, so it chains like any drive, but 5 GB free is 400 accounts per terabyte and the free tier is per HUAWEI ID rather than per device. Non-mainland IDs often cannot buy a plan at all

limits.value: 5 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice

Check whether you can purchase a cloud storage plan in the country or region where your HUAWEI ID is registered, as the service is only supported in some countries or regions outside the Chinese mainland.

identity_cost.detail: Check whether you can purchase a cloud storage plan in the country or region where your HUAWEI ID is registered, as the service is only supported in some countries or regions outside the Chinese mainland.

record.reliability_note: The terms now split 基础服务, unmetered for contacts, SMS and notes, from 会员服务, metered for photos, video and app data. The unmetered half holds no bulk data. Free-space farming exists but is territory-locked to app-install tasks on Huawei handsets

evidence.proved: a live portal served by Huawei Services Hong Kong; a global portal exists but the storage product is region-gated

record.notes: Region-gated cloud service featuring an active WebDAV bridge accessible to mainland accounts. Free storage is limited to 5 GB, and paid subscription pathways require domestic mainland payment verification.
